site.name: Stony Brook at Princeton NJ
site.sourceName: USGS Water Data for the Nation
site.coordinateMethod: Interpolated from map; WGS84; published accuracy ±1 second.

claims.text: Road-salt runoff may reach Stony Brook through a nearby drainage connection.
claims.uncertainty: Conceptual investigation hypothesis. No specific road, pipe, drainage route, or salt transport has been verified.
supports: The monitoring location is documented by USGS; NOAA documents a regional winter event.
doesNotEstablish: A connected drainage pathway from any particular road.
Salt application, chloride concentration, or road-specific causation during this event.
nextEvidenceNeeded: Obtain dated salt-application records and station-matched chloride samples.

claims.text: USGS maps the Stony Brook at Princeton NJ monitoring station at this location.
claims.sourceName: USGS Water Data for the Nation
claims.uncertainty: Coordinates were interpolated from a map; published accuracy is ±1 second. Location does not establish event-matched chloride monitoring.
supports: The station identity and published location in Mercer County, New Jersey.
doesNotEstablish: A causal link between road salt and water quality.
nextEvidenceNeeded: Retrieve and audit station- and event-matched chloride records.

claims.text: An event-matched chloride increase at this station has not been established in this case.
claims.uncertainty: No verified event-matched chloride records have been included; this does not establish that records do not exist elsewhere.
supports: The case contains no validated chloride observations.
doesNotEstablish: A chloride increase, decrease, or absence of chloride.
nextEvidenceNeeded: Retrieve original chloride sample records, including date, station, method, and units.

claims.text: A lower-salt treatment scenario can be explored as a hypothetical material-use assumption.
claims.method: Deterministic material accounting, supplied by the scenario teammate during integration
claims.uncertainty: Scenario defaults are illustrative assumptions, not municipal operations or a validated environmental model.
supports: Hypothetical inputs can support material accounting once the scenario engine is integrated.
doesNotEstablish: Actual treatment quantities or municipal savings.
A stream chloride reduction or a road-safety guarantee.
nextEvidenceNeeded: Obtain treatment records and request an operational safety review.
